note_en: 才 (cái) often marks that something happened only after a condition or delay, like English "only then" or "not until": 后来不少城市划定了专门的停车区域，情况才慢慢好转 "it was only after many cities marked out parking zones that things slowly improved." In 公共交通…才是衡量一个城市宜居程度的重要标准之一, 才是 instead stresses "this, and nothing else, is what really counts," something English does with stress or "really."
